0022600179.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (2-4, 2-2 at home) host the Utah Jazz (1-5) in the eighth game of the 2026-27 season, with New Orleans on a two-game winning streak and Utah on a four-game losing streak. New Orleans is without Dejounte Murray (personal), Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), while Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise). The Pelicans trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 120-119 loss in Salt Lake City on October 23, though they won all three meetings with Utah in 2025-26.
